results.overview: Mi destino eres tú is a 2000 Mexican telenovela. It is a production of Carla Estrada and the protagonists were Lucero and Jorge Salinas.
results.name: Mi Destino Eres Tú

results.overview: Ye Nanzhao is betrayed by her ex-husband and loses her daughter. Kidnapped while seeking justice, she's forced to assume a dead woman’s identity and becomes a concubine in a wealthy household, only to discover her ex-husband is now the family’s new son-in-law. Trapped in a web of lies and buried secrets, she must fight to reclaim her life.
results.name: Be Not Meant to Be

results.overview: Two people living on "parallel lines" were never meant to interact, but an unanticipated meeting transforms them into each other's destiny.  On a cruise ship bound for Hungary, fledgling art editor Chen Jiaxin meets the highly-educated Wang Xiyi, heir to a huge conglomerate. Flaring passions are quickly followed by 'I do's'. Then shortly after the wedding Chen Jiaxin becomes pregnant. She prioritizes  family over her career before suffering a miscarriage.  Heartbroken, she journeys to Hungary alone. There she endures trials and tribulations. But with perseverance and help from friends, she becomes an accomplished potter. Meanwhile, over seven years of separation Wang Xiyi has matured into someone capable of raising a family.  Since so much time has passed, history and possibility converge when the two meet by chance in Hungary.
results.name: You Are My Destiny
